summary: AIFU Inc., a Shenzhen-based insurance agency and brokerage registrant formerly known as Fanhua and CNInsure, furnished a Form 6-K covering its half-year ended June 30, 2026, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer interim report. The excerpt shows only inline XBRL taxonomy tags for ordinary-course items: segment results across agency, health-and-wellness and other units, plus equity compensation under the Million Dollar Round Table and RSU programs. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, deal structure or closing condition is disclosed. Nothing constitutes a special situation; the filing is routine periodic reporting, with no event-driven risk-arb angle to monitor.
